tasks.short: Analyze product failures and laboratory results to find causes and solutions.

steps.what: Collect actual failed-product records and laboratory results and verify material and test identity
Prepare repeated test summaries, distributions and comparisons by actual material and failure category
Check actual summaries and interpret failure mechanisms against laboratory evidence and alternative explanations
Develop defensible material, process or design solutions and required further tests
outputs: selected failure solutions and further tests

steps.what: Write and check actual cause conclusions, solution rationale and remaining uncertainty
inputs: selected failure solutions and further tests

steps.what: Save the checked failure analysis record

tasks.design: Configure native {OTHER} quality-data imports and {SPREADSHEET} or native statistical summaries. Keep material/test identity checks, cause interpretation and solution development human; no automatic root-cause conclusion is generated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated result transfer and statistical preparation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native imports and saved statistical layouts.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguishing a true failure mechanism from correlations or damaged samples.
tasks.human_edge: Develop and test causal explanations using material behaviour.
tasks.altitude: Less result preparation; cause and solution responsibility unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native quality-data imports and statistical summaries reduce preparation without establishing material failure causation.

assumptions: Boundary is analysis of actual failure and lab data through solution record. Quality and laboratory producers supply product/material ID, batch, test method, conditions, units, readings and existing failure category. Engineer verifies mapping and captures missing categories manually in s1; no free classification of narrative reports. s3 checks summary validity and meaning.

Native first. Provisional20 preparation share is actual human repetition, not existing statistical runtime; already imported or summarized data earn zero. Shares not measured. All causal and solution judgement retained. Save1 fully retained; ordinary final record check inside s5.
unknowns: Actual structured-data coverage and current automation
research_questions: Do native imports and summaries preserve material, batch and test comparability?

incremental.description: Maintain lab mappings and summary definitions

approvals.approved_version: s5 checked failure analysis record and actual conclusions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional collection20 reduced50 saves10 plus summary20 removed saves20; gross30 minus2 upkeep=28. Half eligible transfer/preparation gives13. Cause analysis35, solutions15, writing9 and save1 unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Determine suitable material fabrication and joining methods.

steps.what: Establish actual material, geometry, service and manufacturing requirements for fabrication or joining
Find and read current fabrication, joining and qualification evidence for the actual materials
Compare actual candidate methods and choose justified fabrication or joining parameters and limits
Review actual validation evidence and identify unresolved method-qualification needs
outputs: checked method suitability and unresolved qualification

steps.what: Write and check the actual method recommendation, parameters and qualification limitations
inputs: checked method suitability and unresolved qualification

steps.what: Save the checked method recommendation

tasks.design: Configure native {OTHER} material/process filters and {DOCS} qualification links. Keep source reading, method choice, parameter limits, qualification judgement and actual recommendation writing human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding current method and qualification sources.
tasks.enabler_now: Native material/process filters and source links.
tasks.still_hard: Balancing manufacturability, service behaviour and qualification evidence.
tasks.human_edge: Select a defensible method for actual materials and conditions.
tasks.altitude: Less evidence navigation; method responsibility unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native material/process indexes reduce evidence finding without determining actual fabrication or joining suitability.

assumptions: Boundary is method determination through actual recommendation, not fabrication execution. Existing source producers supply material grade, geometry, process record, qualification version and actual evidence; engineer verifies in s1-s2 and records selected parameters in s5. Missing or conflicting evidence requires manual review or further qualification, never inferred approval.

Native first; existing indexes earn zero. Provisional shares not measured. Full technical reading retained; only finding part of s2 changes. Save1 fully retained; ordinary recommendation check inside writing.
unknowns: Current qualification index and source retrieval effort
research_questions: Which actual material/process source lookups repeat?

approvals.approved_version: s5 checked actual method recommendation and limits

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional20 source units reduced25 percent saves5 minus0.5 upkeep=4.5; half eligible finding gives2. Requirements20, method choice40, qualification15, record4 and save1 unchanged.

tasks.short: Guide technical staff developing materials for projected products or devices.

steps.what: Review actual projected-product requirements, development results and technical staff questions
Discuss actual material-development problems and explain technical choices with staff
Observe actual technical work and guide adjustments to material-development methods
Write and check actual development decisions and follow-up in the existing project record
Save the checked development guidance record

tasks.design: Configure native {OTHER} development-result views and {DOCS} requirement links. Keep staff guidance, observation of actual technical work, decisions and real project-record entry human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding current requirements and development results.
tasks.enabler_now: Native project filters and source links.
tasks.still_hard: Diagnosing actual development problems and coaching staff.
tasks.human_edge: Translate product needs into practical technical direction.
tasks.altitude: Less context hunting; technical guidance unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: current project-result views reduce context finding while actual technical guidance and observation remain engineer work.

assumptions: Boundary is focal engineer guidance, observation and actual development record, not staff experiment labour removed. Existing product and test producers supply requirement revision, sample ID, process version and actual results; engineer verifies context in s1 and writes actual decisions in s4. Missing facts require manual investigation.
Native first; existing views earn zero. Provisional shares not measured. Ordinary record accuracy check inside writing; save1 retained, no new approval ceremony.
unknowns: Current project views and actual record duties

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked actual development guidance record

tasks.short: Design and direct tests or controls of materials-processing procedures.

steps.what: Read actual processing requirements, prior control results and relevant test-method sources
Choose actual processing test methods, sampling, acceptance criteria and control responses
Write and check the actual processing test or control protocol
Save the checked final processing protocol
Direct actual testing or process-control work and resolve technical questions during execution
outputs: actual technical direction and observed outcomes

steps.what: Write and check actual directed-test outcomes, deviations and follow-up decisions
inputs: actual technical direction and observed outcomes

steps.what: Save the checked actual test-direction record

tasks.design: Configure native {DOCS} test-source links and protocol headings. Preserve actual test/control design, live technical direction and outcome recording, with protocol preparation before execution and actual outcome entry afterward.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated method-source finding and protocol layout.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source indexes and controlled document templates.
tasks.still_hard: Selecting meaningful tests and resolving actual process deviations.
tasks.human_edge: Adapt technical direction to evidence without losing test validity.
tasks.altitude: Less protocol preparation layout; test authority unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native protocol templates reduce repeated layout while processing-test design and actual technical direction remain engineer work.

assumptions: Boundary includes design and actual direction through its outcome record; technical staff's physical testing is not claimed as removed engineer labour. Process sources supply current requirements, actual results and methods; engineer selects sampling, criteria and responses in s2 and captures protocol fields in s3. Missing sources or fields are handled manually; actual outcomes are captured only after s5.

Native first; existing indexes/templates earn zero. Provisional shares not measured. Ordinary protocol and outcome accuracy checks counted in writing, no extra approval ceremony. Both saves1 fully retained.
unknowns: Current protocol format and actual direction-record duties
research_questions: Which actual source finding and protocol layout work repeats?

incremental.description: Maintain method links and protocol headings

approvals.approved_version: s3 checked final processing protocol before actual execution
s6 checked actual test-direction record after execution
